knownIssues.summary: Datum Label Studio currently runs on Apple silicon Macs only. Intel Macs are not supported.
There is no automatic updater. Updates are downloaded and installed manually.
Physical output varies by printer, driver, stock, feed direction and imageable area. Calibrate every printer and stock combination before production printing.
